title: ASTERIX: process asterix over tcp
description: Port 8600 is registered with IANA for ASTERIX on both TCP and UDP.  This adds TCP capability to the ASTERIX dissector.

notes.body: This invalidates the recursive bounds assumptions in dissect_asterix_fields and asterix_field_length. Can you add increment_dissection_depth and decrement_dissection_depth to those routines?

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19344/diffs?diff_id=1302029598&start_sha=f997ace728307eaf1f5248d1c21d382e1bf8e28a#a7abb2b91d76ca0723db21198333cfa51b4c07ec_434_434)
